opening.argument: The video directs viewers to begin Bitconnect lending through a signup link, promising that they can start with as little as $100 and emphasizing that they will not believe the returns. It bolsters that solicitation with a first-person claim of earning $360 in daily interest from $20,000, while the displayed Bitconnect investment navigation and login page provide the path to participation. The Coinbase/GDAX fee comparison and investment-risk disclaimer add context, but they do not displace the central money-making pitch or its encouragement to lend through Bitconnect.

citations.quote: Click on link to start making money through Bitconnect lending with as little as $100. You won’t believe the returns.
I have personally started lending with $20,000 and the interest alone is making $360 daily.
